_doc: Studies removed from the corpus by decision, keyed by PMID. build_lineage.py sets lineage category '2' for each (as page_view treats category 2); analyses/apply_corpus_exclusions.py sets in_corpus false in analyses/primary_lists.json. Study facts (scope, n_new_genes) are not changed. Corpus criterion: gene coverage that is relatively high and gene selection that is less biased; targeted panels fail the second. No minimum gene count for microarrays (decided 2026-10-11, reversing the 5,000-gene cut of 2026-10-10). Hoseth 2018 (141 Wnt genes on a genome-wide array) is treated as a panel.
